references.text: Parallel text about the rock badger that chews the cud but does not have split hooves, and is therefore unclean
The context for the rules concerning clean and unclean animals - requiring both split hooves and chewing the cud
The hare is mentioned as another example of an animal that chews the cud but does not have split hooves
The pig as a contrasting example - has split hooves but does not chew the cud, also unclean
Mentions the rock badger (שָׁפָן) and its dwelling in the rocks
The rock badgers are described as a weak people who nevertheless build their homes in the rock
